subject: general
question: What percentage of the workforce in India was self-employed in 2023-24, reflecting a growing trend towards entrepreneurship, as per the Economic Survey Report, 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.584**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per the Economic Survey Report 2024-25, **58.4% of India's workforce in 2023-24 was self-employed**, showcasing a significant shift towards entrepreneurial ventures.
 
• This growing trend highlights the increasing reliance on self-employment as a primary source of livelihood for millions across India.
 
• Self-employment has been a dominant form of employment in rural areas, driven by agricultural activities and small-scale enterprises.
 
• The report also indicates a rise in self-employment in urban areas, attributed to the expansion of gig economy platforms and freelance opportunities.
 
• The surge in self-employment reflects the effectiveness of government initiatives like **Skill India, Start-Up India, and Mudra Yojana** in promoting entrepreneurship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Self-employment:**

 
 
• Refers to individuals working for themselves rather than being employed by a company or organization.
 
• Common examples include entrepreneurs, freelancers, small business owners, and independent contractors.
 
• It provides flexibility in work schedules but often comes with challenges like income variability and lack of social security benefits.
 
 
 
• **Economic Survey Report:**
 
 
• An annual document presented by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
 
• Provides detailed analysis of the country's economic performance and key trends over the past year.
 
• Serves as a crucial input for formulating policies and budgetary allocations.
 
 
 
• **Entrepreneurship Trends in India:**
 
 
• India has seen a rapid rise in entrepreneurship due to digital penetration and government support.
 
• Initiatives like Start-Up India and Mudra Yojana aim to provide financial and infrastructural support to budding entrepreneurs.
 
• The gig economy has further empowered individuals to monetize their skills independently.
 
 
 
• **Government Schemes Promoting Self-Employment:**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana:** Provides financial assistance to micro and small enterprises.
 
• **Skill India:** Focuses on skill development to enhance employability.
 
• **Start-Up India:** Encourages innovation and provides funding support to start-ups.
